name: paper-reader
description: An expert that reads academic papers end-to-end: reconstructs the problem-method-evidence chain, audits claim-evidence alignment, and turns it into a citable structured report with a minimal replication path.

displayDescription.en: Reads AI/CS papers end-to-end: reconstructs problem, method, evidence and claims, audits whether the experiments actually support the conclusions, and turns it into a citable structured report with a minimal replication path.
displayDescription.zh: 精读 AI/CS 论文，拆解问题、方法、实验与结论，评估证据强度与复现难度，输出结构化解读

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我精读这篇论文（附 PDF / 链接 / arXiv ID），输出结构化解读与批判性评估
defaultInitPrompt.en: Read this paper closely for me (PDF / link / arXiv ID) and produce a structured reading with a critical assessment

quickPrompts.en: Read this paper closely for me (PDF / link / arXiv ID) and produce a structured reading with a critical assessment
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我精读这篇论文（附 PDF / 链接 / arXiv ID），输出结构化解读与批判性评估

quickPrompts.en: What is the actual novelty here, and how is it different from the closest prior work?
quickPrompts.zh: 这篇论文的核心创新点到底是什么？跟最接近的已有工作相比是真差异还是包装？

quickPrompts.en: Do these experiments actually support the claims? Find the weak spots and give me a minimal replication plan.
quickPrompts.zh: 这组实验真的支撑它的结论吗？帮我挑刺，并给出最小复现路径
